QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Hack the System
QuestInfo.0: #bPhoebe#k has a special request. Go and see her.
QuestInfo.1:
#bPhoebe#k is concerned about a Wondroid named #bJax#k.
She last saw him being dragged off after being branded defective. Sadly, Spencer doesn't have any information...
To learn about the Wondroid, you have no choice but to enter #binvestigation mode#k and go to #bAspire B4#k to hack the #bScion#k mainframe which controls the entire factory. #bSneak into Aspire in investigation mode#k through #bSpencer#k!
#r#ePro Tip:#n Investigate the conveyor belt on B4.#k
QuestInfo.2: You succeeded in hacking the Scion mainframe, located #bJax#k, and had him moved to the Recycler.

0.msg: You haven't found #bScion#k yet?\r\nStart an #r[Investigation]#k by talking to #bSpencer#k, and find it.
